82C8D630.name: Str_BoundedCopy_82C8D630
82C8D630.desc: Copies bytes from src to dst up to a maximum length, stopping at a 0x80-high-byte terminator (the SDK's wide/extended string sentinel). On normal copy it stores the resulting length; on the short-init path it writes a 2-byte length header (sth) and a sentinel byte. Classic Xbox 360 SDK string copy with a size field.
82C8D630.trigger: Internal SDK string handling (no direct player trigger).

82238828.name: Heap_AllocateBlock_82238828
82238828.desc: Large (495-instruction) memory allocator. Guards state with RtlEnter/LeaveCriticalSection, carves blocks out of a region (linked-list free lists at fixed object offsets), and falls back to NtAllocateVirtualMemory when the region is exhausted; raises RtlRaiseException on failure. This is the core block-alloc path of the game's custom heap.
82238828.trigger: Internal — runs whenever the engine allocates a heap block.

822394F0.name: Heap_FreeBlock_822394F0
822394F0.desc: 124-instruction companion to the allocator: returns a block to the free list under RtlEnter/LeaveCriticalSection and releases whole regions via NtFreeVirtualMemory when they become empty. Part of the same custom heap as Heap_AllocateBlock_82238828.
822394F0.trigger: Internal — runs whenever the engine frees a heap block.

824D56C8.name: Math_FloatIndexStore_824D56C8
824D56C8.desc: Loads a float from a global table and a scalar, computes an integer via fcfid/fmadd/fctiwz (round-to-int of a scaled value), then stores that integer at *(r3 + 420). Converts a floating coordinate/parameter into a quantized integer index stored on an object.
824D56C8.trigger: Internal math helper (no direct player trigger).
